description:
Initialization: Sort assigned tasks by descending reward-density divided by one plus log(1 + candidate count), then task ID.

Initialization local search:
- Insert unscheduled tasks in increasing candidate-count order, with reward as a tie-break; test replacement of lower-reward observations, pairwise reversal and single-task reinsertion.

Reassignment:
- Repair: For broken edges, release the endpoint with more candidates; if counts tie, release the lower-reward endpoint. Reconsider incoming tasks and released endpoints.
- Search: Try incoming tasks first, then other pending tasks by candidate scarcity and reward; test insertion, lower-reward replacement, pairwise reversal and reinsertion.
- Control: Submit one edit per feedback attempt; stop when the edit sequence is exhausted. The runtime evaluates and accepts changes.
Purpose: Give scarce observation opportunities more attention and prefer releasing more flexible tasks during broken-edge repair.
